extra.message: req.body.login is concatenated directly into a raw SQL string passed to db.sequelize.query() without parameterization. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g. login=' OR '1'='1) to bypass the WHERE clause or exfiltrate data.

req.body.address is concatenated directly into a shell command executed via child_process.exec() with no sanitization or escaping, allowing arbitrary OS command injection via shell metacharacters (e.g. `; cat /etc/passwd`).

Uploaded file contents (req.files.products.data) are passed directly to node-serialize's unserialize(), which is well-known to allow arbitrary code execution via crafted `_$$ND_FUNC$$_` IIFE payloads in the serialized object.

req.body.eqn is passed unsanitized to mathjs.eval(). Vulnerable mathjs versions allow escaping the expression sandbox to achieve arbitrary code execution (prototype pollution / RCE via crafted expressions).

Uploaded XML (req.files.products.data) is parsed with libxmljs.parseXmlString using {noent:true}, which explicitly enables entity expansion/substitution. This allows XXE attacks to read local files or perform SSRF via external entity declarations (e.g. <!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">).

cwe: CWE-611: Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference

extra.message: req.query.url is passed unvalidated to res.redirect(). The route (GET /app/redirect, routes/app.js:48) has no allowlist check and no authentication requirement, allowing attackers to craft phishing links that redirect through the trusted domain to arbitrary external sites.

cwe: CWE-601: URL Redirection to Untrusted Site ('Open Redirect')

extra.message: output.searchTerm (sourced from req.body.name in core/appHandler.js productSearch, line 68) is rendered with the unescaped EJS tag <%- %>, allowing reflected XSS via the product search form (POST /app/products).

Product name/code/tags/description fields are stored unsanitized from req.body in core/appHandler.js modifyProductSubmit (lines 115-118) and later rendered with unescaped EJS tags <%- %>, allowing stored/persistent XSS that executes for every user who views the product listing.

GET /app/admin/usersapi only requires authHandler.isAuthenticated (any logged-in user), with no check that req.user.role === 'admin'. Any authenticated non-admin user can call this endpoint and retrieve the full user list, including password hashes, via appHandler.listUsersAPI.

db.User.findAll({}) returns full user model instances (including the bcrypt password hash field) which are serialized directly into the JSON API response, exposing sensitive credential data to any authenticated caller.

cwe: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

extra.message: Password reset token is computed as md5(login) with no server-side secret, expiry, or single-use nonce. Since the login/username is typically known or guessable, any attacker can compute a valid reset token for any account without needing access to the victim's email, enabling full account takeover.

The express-session secret is hardcoded as the well-known default string 'keyboard cat'. Anyone with knowledge of this value can forge valid session cookies (with a compatible session store) to hijack or impersonate authenticated sessions.

Session cookie is configured with `secure: false`, allowing the session cookie to be transmitted over unencrypted HTTP connections and increasing exposure to session hijacking via network interception.
